Looping in some transport and contingency details so everyone is aligned.

Transport / curbside ops:
- Marissa will be onsite curb lead from 18:30–20:30. We will reserve two company SUVs as backup (driver names in arrival_manifest.csv). If VIPs indicate rideshare, we will assign a runner to meet them at curbs and escort to security.

Kitchen contingency (unique ask from venue):
- Venue has a small generator (shared house feed) but not a heavy-duty kitchen generator. In the event of a partial power interruption, our contingency is:
  1) Move hot-holding to pre-staged Cambro hot boxes (we'll bring two).
  2) Use two induction burners (we will supply one portable induction unit and one battery-powered induction plate) — chef to confirm compatibility.
  3) Prioritize VIP meal prep first and stagger main service by 10–15 minutes to maintain plating quality.

Please confirm that the caterer is OK with: a) a 15-minute earlier load-in (15:15), and b) testing induction unit compatibility on site during the 17:00 run-through. If yes, I'll add the induction kit to the arrival_manifest and mark it as 'must test'.

Also, I recommend we print a small laminated seating map for floor leads and one extra copy for security — makes last-minute swaps easier.
